- Major update: User identity and authentication is now handled completely internally and automatically, with no user interaction or exposure of internal IDs required.
- Documentation fully rewritten for clarity, brevity, and bilingual support; all end-user prompts related to identity removed.
- Simplified API usage—commands no longer require open-id as a visible parameter.
- Stricter enforcement that all historical report queries must use the official cloud API—local report memory reading is strictly disabled.
- Improved parameter instructions, workflow guidance, and resource index; updated example commands accordingly.

Initial release of Plant Night Respiration Rate Analysis.

- Monitors plant nighttime respiration intensity (0–100%) using thermal imaging and optional CO₂ sensor data.
- AI analyzes leaf-air temperature differences and CO₂ data to estimate metabolic activity.
- Provides alerts on abnormal respiration intensity and environment control suggestions.
- Supports automatic report generation and historical report lookup, with results shown in clear Markdown tables.
- Includes strict open-id acquisition rules for user identification and data retrieval.
